_note: Story 035: what the client says on her own while the nails are painted (the screen is the station then). count: lines per service (random in range). firstAfterSeconds / gapSeconds: timing. ignoreSeconds: a question left unanswered this long costs ignoreMoodDip once (never a walk-out: mood has a floor). checkout: her line when Done leads to checkout, by band: the first band (in order happy, okay) whose minMatch (nail match %) and minMood are both met, else unhappy (still polite). redo: her line for a redo scenario's first Done.

easy: Ooh, that colour looks so pretty!
Is it okay if I check my phone for a second?
How long have you been doing nails?
This is so relaxing. Do you like working here?
Will it be dry before I leave?
medium: Can you make them a little shorter, please?
Is this colour going to last a few weeks?
Oops, sorry, I moved my hand. Is that okay?
Do you think a top coat would help?
Are you almost done? I have to pick up my kids soon.
hard: Careful, that's a little too close to my skin.
Hmm, is that the same shade I picked?
How much longer is this going to take?
The last salon did it faster. Can you hurry a bit?
Can you fix that edge? It doesn't look even.
